system.description:
You cast a willing soul into a lifeless or empty body, giving a free-floating spirit or summoned ghost a temporary home of decaying flesh.

The host must have died within the same scene, or else be a living or undead body bereft of consciousness (for instance, one whose soul you have removed, or that is projecting via Psychic Projection); torpid vampires do not qualify, as the spirit still inhabits the body. With an appropriate host and spirit the process is automatic, requiring no challenge or expenditure. A dead host continues to decay and lasts no more than a week.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
